line.a_ziew.text: Yawn... I slept so well. Is it morning yet?

line.a_ciemno.text: I don't know. Underground it's always dark, and I can't see very well.

line.a_dzien_dobry.text: Good morning, Mole! Get up, it's morning already!

line.a_noc.text: Morning? I thought it was always night.

line.a_zasypane.text: Always night? Look, your way out is full of earth. That's why no light gets in.

line.a_odgarnij.text: Brush the earth away with your finger, and we'll see what's up there!

line.a_swiatlo.text: Oh my, light! And somebody up there is shouting very loudly.

line.a_kto_pieje.text: Point to who is crowing so loudly.

line.a_kto_pieje_nie.text: Not there. Look for the bird on the fence.

line.a_kogut.text: Yes, the rooster! The rooster crows in the morning: cock-a-doodle-doo, get up! And next to him the sun is rising.

line.a_noc_nie.text: So it isn't always night? It really is morning!

line.a_na_gore.text: Come up with us! We'll show you how a whole day goes by: morning, midday, evening and night.

line.b_jasno.text: Oh, how bright! The sun is rising.

line.b_rano.text: Yes, it's morning. In the morning we get up, wash and eat breakfast.

line.b_co_rano.text: Point to what we do in the morning.

line.b_co_rano_nie.text: We do that in the evening. In the morning we eat breakfast.

line.b_caly_dzien.text: The day goes by in order: in the morning the sun rises, at midday it's high, in the evening it sets, and at night the moon shines.

line.b_rysunek.text: Mole, I've got something for you. I drew your whole day!

line.b_wiatr.text: Oh no, the wind! The pictures got all mixed up.

line.b_uloz.text: Put the pictures in order, from morning to night. Start at the arrow.

line.zla_kolejnosc.text: That's not its place. What comes earlier, and what later?

line.b_po_kolei.text: Yes! In the morning Mole gets up, at midday he plays ball, in the evening he walks home, and at night he sleeps.

line.c_wieczor.text: It's getting darker. Is it night already?

line.c_zgubil.text: Not yet, it's evening. Oh dear, little Hedgehog is lost. It got dark and he hid in the bushes.

line.c_poswiec.text: Let's shine a light. Point to a bush, and we'll see if he's there.

line.c_pusto.text: He's not here. Shine on another bush.

line.c_jest.text: There he is! Little Hedgehog is found.

line.c_dom.text: I know him! He lives under the old oak, on the other side of the wood.

line.c_zdazyc.text: But it's getting darker. After the evening comes the night! We must hurry.

line.c_latarenka.text: There are lots of paths in the wood. Let's take a lantern and lead him home along the right path.

line.c_prowadz.text: Lead the little hedgehog with your finger along the path, all the way to his door. He can't go through the bushes.

line.c_sciezka_ok.text: That's the right path! Straight on to the old oak.

line.c_dab.text: Here we are under the old oak. There is the little hedgehog's door, with a light in the window.

line.c_w_domu.text: You're home, little hedgehog. We made it before the night. Good night!

line.c_noc_swietliki.text: Now it's night. How beautiful! I have never seen the stars before.

line.c_gwiazdy.text: Join the stars with your finger, from the smallest to the biggest. Let's see what they make!

line.c_mis.text: A bear! It's the Great Bear. You can only see it in the sky at night.

line.c_juz_wiem.text: Now I know! After the morning comes midday, after midday the evening, after the evening the night, and after the night the morning again.

line.c_dobranoc.text: That's right, Mole! Tonight you sleep at ours, and in the morning we'll wake up together.

line.p_start.text: Let's play with the times of day! I have five games.

line.p_co_dalej.text: Morning, midday, evening... point to what comes next.

line.p_co_dalej_nie.text: After the evening it gets dark. What comes after the evening?

line.p_noc.text: Yes, after the evening comes the night.

line.p_w_nocy.text: Point to what we do at night.

line.p_w_nocy_nie.text: We do that in the morning. At night we sleep.

line.p_spimy.text: At night we sleep in bed.

line.p_trzy.text: Put the pictures in order, start at the arrow.

line.p_trzy_ok.text: Yes: first the morning, then midday, and then the evening!

line.p_memory.text: Turn the cards and find pairs: morning with morning, night with night.

line.p_memory_ok.text: All the pairs found, from morning to night!

line.p_po_nocy.text: Point to what comes after the night.

line.p_po_nocy_nie.text: The evening comes before the night. After the night the sun rises.

line.p_rano_znowu.text: Yes! After the night it's morning again.

line.d_wieczor.text: It's evening. Mole, tonight you sleep at ours, and in the morning we'll all wake up together!

line.d_kret_pizama.text: Evening? Quick then: pyjamas on! And now into the bath!

line.d_mokro.text: Oh no! My pyjamas are all wet.

line.d_najpierw.text: First the bath, and only then the pyjamas. In the evening we do things in order too.

line.d_co_najpierw.text: Point to what we do first in the evening.

line.d_co_najpierw_nie.text: We do that later. First we have a bath.

line.d_uloz.text: Now put the whole evening in order on the rug: a bath, pyjamas, a story and bed. Start at the arrow.

line.d_wieczor_ok.text: A bath, pyjamas, a story, and last the bed. The whole evening in order!

line.d_bajka.text: And now a bedtime story. Once upon a time there was a little mole who saw the sun for the first time. The end!

line.d_ksiazka.text: Put the book away on the bedside table, next to the lamp.

line.d_dobranoc.text: The book on the table, the lamp off. Good night, friends!

line.d_po_nocy.text: We sleep all night. Point to what comes after the night.

line.d_po_nocy_nie.text: Not yet. After the night the sun comes up.

line.d_rano.text: Good morning! It's morning, the sun is shining. I woke up in the morning, together with you!

line.d_rano_ok.text: Good morning, Mole! Yes, after the night the morning always comes.

line.d_opowiedz.text: Mole, tell us about your day yesterday. And you, point to the pictures in order, from the morning.

line.d_kret_rano.text: In the morning we brushed the earth away and I saw the sun. And what came next?

line.d_kret_poludnie.text: At midday we put the pictures in order on the meadow. And what came next?

line.d_kret_wieczor.text: In the evening we took little Hedgehog home. And what came next?

line.d_kret_noc.text: And at night I saw the Great Bear and slept at your place.

line.d_rodzice.text: Now you tell your parents what happened this morning, at midday and this evening.

line.naklejka_daj.text: Thank you for showing me a whole day! Here is a sticker for your album. Touch it to take it.

line.naklejka_juz.text: You already have the sticker from this adventure. See you!

line.naklejka_opis.text: This is the night with the moon. Mole gave it to us when we learnt the times of day in order.
